correctness.rationale: For the stated shift and negative-sign plane waves the energies are 2h cos((2πk+Φ)/N). The only nontrivial cosine degeneracy pairs satisfy k+ℓ+Φ/π≡0 modulo N. At Φ=mπ a nonfixed pair permits a unique cancelling direction at vertex 0, which vanishes at d exactly when M divides 2k+m. That congruence has C_m solutions among the N indices, including exactly S_m fixed points of the involution. Dividing the nonfixed solution count by two yields the stated cases including odd N, coprime separations and the antipodal case. Imaginary parts of K eigenvalues force every real-energy eigenvector into the common loss kernel; that dark span reduces K, and on its complement Jordan blocks with strictly negative imaginary energy still decay. Orthogonality gives the limit for all density matrices, including coherent inputs. Flux period changes are site gauges, with projectors and coherent inputs expressed in the same gauge. I inspected the actual nested verification/check_cycle.py and the verification notes; finite propagation in that script is illustrative only. The independent replay /workspace/branches/frozen-review-replay.py also checks 18 cut-gauge eigenspace intersections, including gain (6,2), loss (8,2), and odd N.
